messages:
Lee: Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands — creating a quick thread for live Q&A follow-ups and owners. I'll capture what I said I'd confirm.

Ana: High-level Qs I saw: Dedicated GA date, Private deployment pilot status, and the Cost/Optimize playbook. Short answers below.

Ana: Dedicated GA target: 2026-05-15 for NA regions. We need one more perf sweep on select 40B configs but timing is OK. Will update release notes when sweep completes.

Raj: Quick one — SLA tiers: sales asked whether we support 99.95% vs 99.9% out of the box.

Ana: SLA plan: 99.95% will be the standard GA offering; 99.9% is an enterprise add-on (pricing + capacity commitment). Morgan will publish the SLA doc & template.

Morgan: I’ll own the SLA doc. Action: Morgan -> post draft by Mon 2026-03-30 and tag Legal and Sales for review. Draft link (internal): https://redwood.internal/docs/sla-draft (placeholder).

Sasha: Any changes to Private deployment / VPC timeline compared to roadmap slide?

Jamie: Private (customer-managed control plane) pilot infra is on track for June. We have 3 pilot customers targeted. Security review is still in flight — NatSec will report next week.

Lee: Cost playbook / Optimize: we will surface model/quantization recommendations in Console during Q2. Action: Lee + EngInfra to create a short "Cost Playbook" guide and a Console CTA for suggested settings.

Lee: Action items summary (concise):
- Morgan: SLA doc + template by 2026-03-30 (tag Legal, Sales)
- Lee & EngInfra: Cost Playbook draft + Console CTA by 2026-04-10
- Jamie: Private pilot status update (infra & security blockers) by 2026-04-24
- Raj: Sync with Sales on enterprise SLA pricing & commit levels by 2026-04-05

Raj: I'll sync with Sales — looping in Ben from Sales here. @Ben can you take the pricing review?

Ben: Yep, I'll coordinate with Raj and Legal. Will carve out 2 hours this week to review assumptions. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: Perf-sweep notice: job-112 completed at 03:05 UTC; observed 2 minor mem OOMs on p4-8 during long-seq load tests. Logs: http://ci.internal/logs/job-112 (internal).

Lee: Thanks all — if folks want to volunteer for private pilot customer testing or early console UX review, reply here and I'll add you to the list.

Ana: Appreciate the quick responses — will follow up on release note when sweep status is green. :sparkles:
